hypothesis: A 4h EMA20 pullback recross in a training-defined SOL trend/normal-volatility context, with BTC 4h trend confirmation, may produce positive net expectancy after an all-in round-trip cost proxy and historical SOL funding.

scope.positionSize: 1 SOL fixed quantity; no compounding; one position at a time

solFunding.integrity: DEGRADED_HASH_MISMATCH; preserve both hashes; do not overwrite prior manifest

ema.method: recursive EMA; current bar close included only after bar completion

detector.eligibleContext: SOL trend is BULL or BEAR; ATR14/close is between train q33 and q67; not SHOCK
detector.btcConfirmation: BTC EMA50/EMA200 trend is non-flat and has the same direction as SOL

rules.longEntry: At completed 4h bar i: SOL close[i-1] <= EMA20[i-1], close[i] > EMA20[i], close[i] > open[i], SOL context BULL_NORMAL, BTC trend BULL. Enter at bar i+1 open.
rules.shortEntry: At completed 4h bar i: SOL close[i-1] >= EMA20[i-1], close[i] < EMA20[i], close[i] < open[i], SOL context BEAR_NORMAL, BTC trend BEAR. Enter at bar i+1 open.
rules.stop: 1.5 * ATR14 at signal close from next-bar open; adverse gap-through exits at open.
rules.target: 2.0R; if stop and target both touch within one bar, stop is assumed first; favorable gap-through target fills at target.
rules.sizing: 1 SOL fixed quantity; no leverage/compounding; one active position; no same-bar re-entry.
noTrade: last 12 bars of a test segment

evaluation.chronologicalSplits: Anchored walk-forward: train 40%, validate 10%, test 10%; train 50%, validate 10%, test 10%; train 60%, validate 10%, test 10%; final split train 60%, validation 20%, untouched test 20%.
evaluation.thresholdFit: Re-fit context thresholds on each fold's training slice only. Final test thresholds use first 60% only. Validation is diagnostic only; no parameter selection.
baselines: same pullback rules without BTC confirmation
evaluation.uncertainty: Moving-block bootstrap by 4-week UTC clusters, 2,000 resamples, deterministic seed 20261106; Bonferroni family alpha 0.05/6 for BTC-filter/stop-neighborhood comparisons.

costs.funding: Use historical SOL fundingRate events; markPrice when present, otherwise last completed 4h close at/before settlement as a notional proxy; record proxy count.

reproducibility.codeRuntime: managed V8 Code Mode; repository Node CLI is not invoked because local checkout is absent and Node/npm are below package engine floor

implementationCorrection: v1 runner label() referenced threshold fields at the wrong object level (th.flat/th.q33/th.q67/th.shock instead of th.sol.*), forcing every bar into SIDEWAYS_NORMAL. v1 result is invalidated; v1.1 preserves the exact trading rules and fixes only threshold lookup.
